I posted a reply in #strategic-pod telling you I can't set up the 17:30 weekday "Pod end of day" note. I didn't create a scheduled job.

The reason: scheduled jobs created from this session deliver their output only locally. Nothing in this setup would reliably post to #strategic-pod at 17:30 each weekday. I didn't test that path, so treat it as my reading of the setup. I can post a digest of the day's #strategic-pod messages whenever you ask.
